comment: The map feature's words — the drawn surface, what it draws and how a person moves it.

rows.definition: One installed, versioned set of map data a view can be pointed at.
rows.not: not the stylesheet that decides how that data is coloured

rows.definition: One square of rendered map at one magnification, drawn and cached as a unit.
rows.not: not a frame, which is a whole canvas of tiles
anchor: case: app: RouteRowDerivationTest rows tile the polyline without a gap or an overlap

rows.definition: The counter that tells a consumer whether the data it drew has been replaced since.
rows.not: not a timestamp, which says when the data arrived
anchor: rule: Pure GPS position updates must NOT increment the epoch

rows.definition: A glyph pinned to one map position, drawn above the map content.
rows.not: not an overlay, which paints rather than pins

rows.definition: The rectangle of the map world a surface currently shows, in world terms rather than pixels.
rows.not: not the canvas size the viewport is drawn into
anchor: rule: The viewport keeps the FINAL magnification while the display walks.

rows.definition: To change the magnification a viewport holds, leaving its centre where it was unless a follow mode moves it.
rows.not: not a pan, which moves the centre at one magnification
anchor: case: app: MapCanvasDoubleTapZoomTest double tap at the maximum magnification leaves the viewport alone

rows.definition: The declared set of rendering rules a basemap is drawn through.
rows.not: not the palette the app's own chrome uses
anchor: case: auto: MapScreenTest a style switch loads the stylesheet set once

rows.definition: One stackable group of map content that can be shown or hidden as a whole.
rows.not: not a marker, which is one pinned object
anchor: rule: the speed-camera and police-checkpoint layers sit behind a country-keyed feature gate, off by default.

rows.definition: Content painted over the map for one presentation, owning no map data of its own.
rows.not: not a layer, which is map content and moves with the map
anchor: rule: a Compose map-content overlay sits above the frame bitmap and below the markers

rows.definition: One host-owned drawing target a map renderer is given and never owns.
rows.not: not the frame, which is the bitmap the renderer fills for it
anchor: rule: CRITICAL — the renderer never owns the surface

rows.definition: The component that fills a frame from the map data and hands it to the surface.
rows.not: not the surface, which the host owns

rows.definition: The point of a follow viewport, as a fraction of the canvas, that the followed position is drawn at.
rows.not: not the viewport's centre, which a browse viewport keeps
anchor: rule: The anchor fraction is relative to the map canvas, and the resolved value is published once.

rows.definition: The smoothed view a follow mode animates, as distinct from the raw fix driving it.
rows.not: not the fix, which is where the device is
anchor: rule: the session's own camera moves are the only ones while it is open.

rows.definition: The control that returns a turned map to north and reports how far it is turned.
rows.not: not the bearing of the vehicle, which the map may follow
anchor: rule: the compass palette is per-presentation, never a theme role.

rows.definition: The direction of travel over the ground, in degrees clockwise from north.
rows.not: not the map's rotation, which is the direction the canvas is turned
anchor: case: auto: NavigationTemplateMapperTest a known exit ordinal selects a number-bearing maneuver type

rows.definition: The radius the platform reports a position might be wrong by.
rows.not: not the distance to the next step, which is measured along the route

rows.definition: A touch sequence a person makes on the map canvas, recognised as one intent.
rows.not: not a key or a car-host command, which arrives from outside the canvas

rows.definition: How far the map is zoomed in, as the factor the projection is computed at.
rows.not: not the number of times a person tapped
anchor: rule: The viewport keeps the FINAL magnification while the display walks.
